## betterChromVAR

```{r}
load(file="../chromVAR_benchmark_30kcells/value_comparisons_hex.RData")
cors$cor <- sapply(as.numeric(gsub("r=","",cors$cor)), \(x) bquote(rho==.(x)))
p1 <- ggplot(hex_df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_abline(slope=1, linetype="dashed") + geom_hex(stat = "identity", aes(fill=count)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey80", high="darkred", trans="sqrt", breaks=c(1,1e6,4e6,9e6)) +
  theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~assay, scale="free") + 
  geom_text(data=cors, aes(x=-Inf, y=Inf, label=cor), vjust = 1.15, hjust=-0.1) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text=element_text(size=11)) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  labs(x="Original chromVAR (average of 2 seeds)", y="betterChromVAR")
```

```{r}
files <- Sys.glob("../chromVAR_benchmark_30kcells/results/scPrinter_*.h5ad.stages.json")
names(files) <- sub("\\.h5ad\\.stages\\.json$", "", basename(files))
scp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(files), function(m) {
  j <- read_json(files[[m]], simplifyVector=TRUE)
  m <- sub("_cpu", " (CPU)", sub("_gpu", " (GPU)", m))
  data.frame(method=m,
             variable=c("Max memory (GiB)", "Running time (min)"),
             value=c(j$maxrss_self_MB/1024,
                     (j$total_s-j$time_through_motif_matching_s) / 60),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
rownames(scp) <- NULL

lf <- list.files("../chromVAR_benchmark_30kcells/benchmarks", full=TRUE)[-1]
names(lf) <- gsub("chromVAR_|\\.txt", "", basename(lf))
d <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(lf[grep("scPrinter", lf, invert=TRUE)], read.delim), .id="method")
d[["Running time (min)"]] <- (d$s-d$s[nrow(d)])/60
d[["Max memory (GiB)"]] <- d$max_rss/1024
row.names(d) <- d$method
d <- d[c("original","ArchR","betterChromVAR","betterChromVARkNN"), c(1, ncol(d)-(0:1))]
d <- reshape2::melt(d, id.vars="method")
d$variable <- relevel(d$variable, grep("time", levels(d$variable), value=TRUE))
d <- rbind(d, scp)
d$method <- factor(d$method, rev(c("original", "ArchR", "scPrinter (CPU)", "scPrinter (GPU)",
                                   "betterChromVARkNN", "betterChromVAR")))
levels(d$method) <- gsub("kNN","-kNN",levels(d$method))
p2 <- ggplot(d, aes(method, value)) + geom_col(fill="darkblue", width=0.85) + 
  xlab(NULL) + coord_flip() + facet_wrap(~variable, scale="free", nrow=2) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text=element_text(size=11)) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```


```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6.5}
pdf("Figure_betterChromVAR.pdf", width=10, height=6.5)
plot_grid(
  plot_grid(p1, p1b, nrow=2, labels="AUTO"),
  plot_grid(p2, p1c, nrow=2, labels=c("C","D")),
  ncol=2, rel_widths = c(5,3)
)
dev.off()
```
